title: Down the Rabbit Hole: Detecting Online Extremism, Radicalisation, and Politicised Hate Speech

bias_targets.methodology: Mapping researcher institution locations against dataset geolocational origins to demonstrate the marginalization of the Global South and Oceania in extremism research.
Analyzing the distribution of target groups across studies to reveal a disproportionate focus on Islamic extremism, highlighting an Islamophobic trend in academia.

Evaluating the political and organizational affiliations targeted in datasets, noting a skew towards specific ideologies (e.g., Islamic extremism) while underrepresenting others like far-right, white supremacist, or far-left ideologies.

Critiquing the demographic and linguistic makeup of datasets, highlighting the dominance of US/Western contexts and the lack of intersectional, indigenous, or non-Western ethno-linguistic evaluations.
